answer_1.quote: We introduce a corruption-based augmentation strategy for essays (CASE), which starts with a well-written essay and incorporates a certain portion of sentence-level errors into the synthetic essay. ... For LLM to generate synthetic essays, we first give the persona of an EFL student ... and provide five example essays ... We then ask the model to write an essay that matches the rubric-based scores.

answer_2.quote: We measure a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) score to measure the similarity between the gold label of the synthetic sample and the predicted score by an AES model.
